AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

EnterpriseIds.description: Unique identifiers of the [Enterprises](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/#enterprise). If not specified, all enterprises within scope of the Access Token are returned.

ExternalIdentifiers.description: Identifiers of the [Enterprise](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/#enterprise) from external system.

LinkedUtc.title: Time interval
LinkedUtc.description: Interval in which enterprises were linked.

UpdatedUtc.title: Time interval
UpdatedUtc.description: Interval in which enterprises were updated.

Limitation.description: Limitation on the quantity of data returned.
